test_title: PYST 31: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 19 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

________ advice you gave me was very useful for solving the issue.
solution:
The correct answer is '**The**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**The**" is used when referring to something specific or already known to the listener or reader.
 
• In the given sentence, the blank refers to a specific piece of advice that was given earlier, so "**The**" is the most appropriate choice.
 
• **Options 1, 3, and 4** are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The __advice you gave me was very useful for solving the issue."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "A piece"** is incorrect because the sentence does not refer to a single piece of advice but to advice in general.
 
• **Option 3: "An"** is incorrect because "advice" is an uncountable noun and does not require "An."
 
• **Option 4: "A"** is incorrect because "advice" is uncountable, so "A" cannot be used before it.
